title: Close algorithmic benchmark gaps from 64c88ae4
description:
Close the algorithmic performance gaps surfaced by `64c88ae4` that are outside the existing Tier A-D SIMD-routing/kernel plan: GF(2) matrix multiply needs a Strassen-Winograd layer above M4RM, GF(p) FieldMatrix multiplication needs delayed-reduction/cache-blocked arithmetic comparable to fflas-ffpack, and GF(2^m) FieldMatrix multiplication needs a batch/PCLMUL-aware matrix path rather than scalar per-element multiplication.

## Background

`dev/bench_results/2026-04-26.md` and `dev/bench_results/2026-04-26-uncompetitiveness-profile.md` show gf2 is far from state-of-the-art on the benchmark suite: GF(2) matmul is about 0.07-0.21x of M4RI, small-prime GF(p) fgemm is about 0.00-0.03x of fflas-ffpack, and GF(2^m) matrix multiplication is dominated by scalar per-element multiplication. The existing PPC Tier A-D plan is necessary but not sufficient: SIMD routing removes dispatch and kernel overhead, but does not add the algorithmic layers used by specialized systems.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Every child task is completed or explicitly rejected with a reason recorded in JIT.
- [hard] The story-level review maps each `64c88ae4` benchmark-gap finding to a landed implementation, a measured non-viability result, or a follow-up issue outside this epic.
- [hard] `cargo-ci` and `code-review` gates pass at story closure.
- [hard] No `unsafe` is introduced outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [aspirational] The combined work materially improves the worst published `64c88ae4` ratios: GF(2) matmul at n>=1024, small-prime GF(p) fgemm, and GF(2^m) fgemm.
